units: <cite ref="Megillah 21a:1">Meg. 21ᵃ</cite> top; <cite ref="Sanhedrin 11b:9">Snh. 11ᵇ</cite> <he>מה מ׳ ביום וכ׳</he> as sentence can be passed in day-time only &c.
<cite ref="Mishnah Eduyot 2:10">Eduy. II, 10</cite> <he>מִשְׁפַּט רשעים וכ׳</he> the judgment (punishment) of the wicked in Gehenna lasts twelve months. Tanḥ.

<cite ref="Exodus 1">Mishp. 1</cite> <he>בעל זרוע אינו רוצה לעשות דבריו במ׳ אלא מעביר על המ׳</he> a man of might does not care to act according to law, but ignores the law; a. fr.—Pl. <he>מִשְׁפָּטִים</he>.
<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 30:1">Ex. R. s. 30</cite> <he>על ידי המ׳ שנתת להם וכ׳</he> through the laws which thou hast given to them, they, having a dispute with one another, go to law and make peace.

<cite ref="Shemot Rabbah 30:15">Ib.</cite> <he>בבקר ניתנה התורה … נתנו המ׳</he> in the morning the Law (religious principles) was given, and in the evening the civil law (<cite ref="Exodus 21">Ex. XXI</cite>, sq.).
Midr. Till. to Ps. XXXVI אין קצבה למ׳ וכ׳ there is no limit to the judgments for the wicked; a. fr.—Mishpatim, name of a Scriptural lesson of a week (Ex. XXI, 1 to XXIV, 18).
